html:
Adopt an HQ ERP cost-effectively with FDAM franchise ERP's 1-month free trial and government subsidies

franchise ERP, FDAM, free trial, government subsidy, franchisor headquarters, e-contracts, POS integration, sales management, HQ operations system, franchise solution

Key takeaways

· With a 1-month free trial, you can run FDAM franchise ERP in your own HQ environment.

· With government subsidies, it's an ERP you can adopt at a reasonable cost for up to 2 years.

· Franchise inquiries, consultations, contracts, and store operations are handled in one system, streamlining HQ workflows into a single line.

· E-contracts, POS integration, and sales management work on one screen, speeding up decisions for the HQ operations team.

A franchise ERP is an operations system built for headquarters that brings HQ's sales, contract, store opening, and operations work into one system, so the data needed to manage stores flows across departments. ERP systems are becoming more and more important to franchisor HQ operations, but many HQ teams find the adoption cost a burden.

FDAM, from MS Venter, which has focused on franchise IT for nearly 25 years, is an ERP you can try firsthand in your own HQ environment with a 1-month free trial, and run at a reasonable cost for up to 2 years with government subsidies. In this post, we walk through FDAM's core features along with how to use the free trial and government subsidies.

Experience the ERP in your own HQ environment first, with no cost burden.

1. Why you no longer need to worry about ERP adoption costs

A free trial and government subsidies together ease the burden of adopting an HQ ERP.

An ERP is infrastructure for HQ operations, but for an HQ adopting one for the first time, cost and operational burden come together. FDAM is designed to address these burdens in two stages.

Two ways to adopt FDAM cost-effectively

① 1-month free trial: Use it firsthand in your HQ environment before deciding

② Government subsidies: Run the ERP at a reasonable cost for up to 2 years

First, your HQ operations team follows the sales, contract, and operations flow on real screens during the 1-month free trial. Then, for HQ teams that decide to adopt, we explain a cost-effective operating cost structure using government subsidies. "Try it first, then run it cost-effectively" is the basic path to adopting FDAM.

2. Why FDAM franchise ERP is a great fit for HQ

HQ workflows carry straight through inside the system.

FDAM is an integrated solution designed to manage the complex work of franchisor headquarters in one system. Based on experience working with about 500 brands, the flow from franchise inquiries to consultations, contracts, store opening preparation, and operations management is built directly into the module design. It cuts the time spent re-gathering scattered materials and creates an environment where the HQ operations team can spend its time on decisions and store management.

E-contracts: digitizing the franchise contract flow

FDAM's e-contract feature organizes the complex franchise contract process into a single flow. You can review and manage contracts digitally, without the hassle of paper documents. Evidence for calculating the 14-day review period required by the Franchise Business Act and for responding to disputes also accumulates in the system automatically.

· Cut management costs and time by digitizing contracts

· Shorten franchise contract lead times with e-signatures

· Reduce dispute risk by tracking delivery and history of pre-contract disclosure documents

· See contract status by stage on one screen

POS integration: standardized aggregation of store sales

FDAM integrates with stores' POS systems to aggregate and display each store's sales data by HQ standards. POS sales are aggregated on a next-day basis, so sales right after same-day closing don't appear on the HQ screen immediately, but data accumulated by the same standard every day arrives at HQ the next day in an organized form. Less time spent processing sales data means faster decisions at HQ.

· Compare sales by store and by channel on one screen

· Standardized sales data that accumulates on a next-day basis

· HQ operations team spends time on analysis and judgment instead of data processing

Sales management: one flow from franchise inquiry to contract

FDAM integrates with your brand website, so franchise inquiries show up directly in the sales management module. Consultation stages and contract progress can be managed on one screen, letting HQ run new store expansion by consistent standards. Ask the AI assistant, the first built into a franchise ERP in Korea, something like "Compare consultation conversion rates by channel for last quarter," and it instantly returns an organized answer with tables and charts.

· Real-time alerts for new franchise inquiries

· Manage every stage from consultation to contract at a glance

· Compare inflow performance by channel and campaign to guide ad budget decisions

3. Reduce costs with government subsidies

With government subsidies, you can run it at a reasonable cost for up to 2 years.

FDAM is an ERP you can adopt with government subsidies. With subsidies applied, you can build and maintain your HQ operations system at a reasonable cost for up to 2 years.

What government subsidies can cover may vary depending on your HQ's business type and the program that applies, so we provide guidance tailored to your HQ during the sales consultation. The most natural path is to confirm the system's fit with the 1-month free trial first, then decide whether to use government subsidies.

Frequently asked questions

Q. How do we sign up for the 1-month free trial?

Contact us through the FDAM sales inquiry page (fdam.co.kr/register), our KakaoTalk channel, or our main number (1544-7120, Korea), and we'll walk you through the free trial sign-up process. When you sign up, we'll review your HQ operating environment together and design a module setup suited to your trial.

Q. Can we use all features during the free trial?

You can try the core features of the sales management, store opening management, and operations management modules, tailored to your HQ operating environment. We design the trial scope around the work your HQ most wants to tackle first, so you can use it in a form close to real operating scenarios rather than a simple demo.

Q. Which HQ teams can use government subsidies?

Eligibility for government subsidies depends on factors such as your HQ's business type, revenue size, and the applicable program. During the sales consultation, we'll explain the programs and procedures available to your HQ and design the most suitable cost structure with you.

Q. Can we use the free trial and government subsidies together?

Yes. The most common path is to confirm the system's fit with the 1-month free trial first, then decide whether to use government subsidies. The two steps proceed in sequence, and during the sales consultation we'll guide you through each stage to fit your HQ's schedule.

Q. Can we migrate our existing spreadsheet data too?

Prospective franchisee information, store information, and other data organized in your existing spreadsheets can be migrated into the system during initial setup. During the sales consultation, we review your HQ's data structure together and recommend the best migration approach.
